data.title: New academy eyes future champions
data.description: Bangkok's newest sporting venture, North Star Park, formally launched its flagship academy on Thursday, with organisers hoping it will produce future tennis grand slam champions and golf major winners.

data.title: Too many distractions at World Cup final
data.description: It is a pity that World Cup final will probably be remembered more for the longest half-time ever than the football squeezed in either side of it. Not that the match itself was anything to shout about with Argentina seemingly intent on a physical display rather than scoring goals.

data.title: Dechapol, Supissara reach semi-finals
data.description: Mixed doubles pair Dechapol Puavaranukroh and Supissara Paewsampran booked their berth in the semi-finals of US$2 million BWF China Open yesterday, but women's singles star Ratchanok Intanon went down to home hope Chen Yufei yesterday.

data.title: Thai footballers gunning for strong start
data.description: Thailand coach Anthony Hudson has tipped his squad's younger players to make a telling contribution at the Asean Hyundai Cup 2026, as the War Elephants launch their bid for a record eighth title against Laos in Vientiane on Saturday.

data.title: James hopes to bring title magic to Philadelphia 76ers
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - LeBron James announced on Friday he will play for the Philadelphia 76ers next season, with the 41-year-old NBA superstar hoping to transform another franchise into a championship team.

data.title: Thailand’s King Power explores Leicester sale
data.description: The Thai owners of Leicester City FC are reportedly considering selling the club that has gone from the height of Premier League glory a decade ago to struggling in English football’s third tier.

data.title: Rugby brain injury court case at risk of collapse
data.description: LONDON - A landmark legal case involving hundreds of former rugby players who allege they suffered brain injuries during their careers is on the brink of collapse.

data.title: Klopp handed task of reviving Germany’s football fortunes
data.description: FRANKFURT - Jurgen Klopp has been named Germany coach, the former Liverpool manager given the task of rebuilding the struggling European giants, the national federation (DFB) announced on Friday.

data.title: ONE Championship: Malaysian PM Anwar backs Aliff to make history in long-awaited title shot
data.description: Malaysian Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim has thrown his support behind Aliff Sor Dechapan as the 22-year-old finally receives his long-awaited ONE Championship title shot on Friday night.

data.title: Is 'superstar' Pogacar's Tour de France domination boring?
data.description: ORCIèRES-MERLETTE (FRANCE) - With Tadej Pogacar on the brink of a record-equalling fifth Tour de France aged only 27 many people are saying his domination has made cycling boring.

data.title: ONE Championship lands Qatar deal for multiple numbered events
data.description: ONE Championship will return to Qatar in March 2027 after agreeing a new three-year partnership that is expected to bring multiple numbered events to the country.

data.title: Fury, Wach tip scales for Pattaya clash
data.description: PATTAYA: Tyson Fury will enter tonight's heavyweight clash against Mariusz Wach as the lighter man for the first time in his professional career after both men weighed in yesterday ahead of their bout at Max Muay Thai Arena in Pattaya.

data.title: Ratchanok survives another scare
data.description: Ratchanok Intanon survived another three-game test to advance to the quarter-finals of the US$2 million BWF China Open on Thursday.

data.title: War Elephants kick off Asean bid in Laos
data.description: Thailand's national football team departed for Laos on Thursday ahead of Saturday's opening Group B fixture against the hosts in the Asean Football Championship, also known as the Hyundai Cup.

data.title: Glasgow hosts slimmed-down Commonwealth Games
data.description: GLASGOW, Scotland - The Commonwealth Games remains a stage “where champions are made” as Glasgow prepares to host a slimmed-down version of the event, says the president of Commonwealth Sport, Dr Donald Rukare.

data.title: Fury in Pattaya ring tomorrow
data.description: PATTAYA: Tyson Fury declared he feels "at peace with everything" as he addressed the media on Wednesday ahead of his heavyweight bout against Mariusz Wach, which takes place tomorrow (Friday) at the 1,500-seat Max Muay Thai Arena in Pattaya.

data.title: Philipsen snaps ‘horrible’ drought with Tour de France stage win
data.description: VOIRON, France - Jasper Philipsen admitted he had been feeling the pressure before sprinting to a dominant victory from a reduced bunch at the end of the Tour de France's Alpine 17th stage on Wednesday, to end a "horrible" run of near misses.

data.title: ONE Championship: Rodtang re-signs after contract war as promotion plots grand comeback
data.description: Rodtang Jitmuangnon is staying with ONE Championship after signing a new contract with the promotion – completing an extraordinary reconciliation only three months after their relationship descended into public accusations and legal action across three countries.

data.title: Argentine Football Association denies US detained its president
data.description: BUENOS AIRES - Argentina's top football officials on Wednesday firmly denied reports that their federation's president and treasurer were detained and questioned upon leaving the United States after the World Cup final.

data.title: Dutch riders dreaming of crazy party corner of Alpe d'Huez
data.description: VOIRON (FRANCE) - Dutch corner is known for being the biggest and craziest party in cycling.
